candidates.change_summary: Replace the final statement 'return true;' with 'return false;' so a successful call returns false instead of true.
Delete the statement require(_tos.length > 0); so calling with an empty _tos array now returns true instead of reverting, and no token transfers occur in a case where P would revert.
Delete the require(_s) check so failed transferFrom calls no longer revert, allowing transfer to complete and return true even when a token transfer fails.
Change the loop bound to i < _tos.length - 1 so the last recipient's transfer is skipped, changing which token movements occur.
Replace v[i] with v[0] in the transferFrom call so every recipient receives the amount intended only for the first recipient.
